title: 31 U.S.C. § 5103
source: United States Code title 31 section 5103, retrieved from Cornell LII (law.cornell.edu). The statutory text is a U.S. government work and is public domain; Cornell's annotations are excluded.

sections.text: § 5103. Legal tender. United States coins and currency (including Federal reserve notes and circulating notes of Federal reserve banks and national banks) are legal tender for all debts, public charges, taxes, and dues. Foreign gold or silver coins are not legal tender for debts.
